stem:
Varun compares a small steel spoon and a large foam packing block from a parcel. On a balance, the spoon is heavier than the foam block.

What can he correctly conclude?

options.text: The spoon has more mass than the foam block.
The spoon has more volume than the foam block because it is heavier.
The spoon has less mass than the foam block, and the foam block has more mass, even though the spoon is heavier on the balance.
He cannot compare their masses unless both sit in identical half-filled cups.

teacher.key_rationale: Heavier means greater mass. Mass is not the same as volume; reversing heaviness and mass is wrong; identical cups are not required to compare masses.
